name: AI Founder Dinner
shortDescription: An intimate dinner for AI founders and builders.
description: A small-table evening for people building at the edge of AI, with no stage and enough time for real conversation.

name: Future Interfaces
shortDescription: A working session on spatial computing beyond the demo.
description: Designers and engineers unpack what makes spatial products useful after the novelty wears off.

name: Product.ai Golden Hour
shortDescription: Builders, operators and friends at the Product.ai home base.
description: A low-pressure late afternoon to compare notes, meet the Alpha Team and reset before the evening run.

name: Robots in the Real World
shortDescription: Live demos from teams shipping physical intelligence.
description: A tactile showcase of robotics products moving from research into warehouses, homes and public space.

name: Designing for Trust
shortDescription: A practical panel on making intelligent products legible.
description: Product leaders and designers share the patterns they use to make high-stakes AI decisions understandable.

name: Climate Hardware Open House
shortDescription: An open studio for climate hardware and materials teams.
description: Walk through early prototypes and talk directly with the teams building them.

name: Consumer AI After Hours
shortDescription: Consumer founders trade lessons from the first million users.
description: Fast stories, candid misses and a room built for meeting other consumer builders.

name: Build the Strange Thing
shortDescription: A six-hour creative technology build sprint.
description: Small teams make a playful prototype, then show the room what they learned.
